symptom: describe page/snippet -> exec on a Studio Pro page silently removes a button's confirmation (ConfirmationInfo -> nil), its progress bar (ProgressBar Blocking/NonBlocking -> None) and progress message, resets a microflow call's Asynchronous/FormValidations, flips DisabledDuringExecution false -> true on actions and on the empty NoAction event slots of every input widget, and deletes OnLeaveAction from check boxes, date pickers and radio button groups; mx check and the build stay green (#721 L2, 18 round-trip allowlist entries)
cause: The action settings had no MDL spelling, so clientActionToGen/microflowSettingsToGen wrote constants for all of them (DisabledDuringExecution true, ProgressBar None, null message and confirmation, Asynchronous false, FormValidations All), and three input-widget cases never set OnLeaveAction
fix: New `with ( Key: value )` settings list after any page action (grammar actionSettingsV3, visitor validates keys per action type, ast.ActionSettingsV3 -> pages.ActionExecution/FlowCallSettings -> writer); describe prints only non-default settings. NoAction slots have no behaviour to spell, so their DisabledDuringExecution is carried from the stored widget of the same name (carryNoActionExecution in UpdatePage/UpdateSnippet). OnLeaveAction written for CheckBox/DatePicker/RadioButtonGroup. A blank message is a Text with no translations, not en_US ''
insight: Split the constants by whether they mean something: a setting with behaviour (a confirmation, a progress bar, disabled-while-running on a real action) gets a spelling so a fresh script can say it too; a value on a slot that runs nothing (DisabledDuringExecution on a NoAction, 946 false vs 380 true on the fixtures) is carried, not spelled. Measure the stored population per slot, not per type: a NoAction under an Action key is true on 20954 of 20984, and majority-false on the input-widget events. The last diff to go was a blank ProgressMessage stored as a Text with zero translations
test: TestClientActionToGen_MicroflowSettings, TestCarryNoActionExecution, TestWidgetToGen_InputWidgetsWriteOnLeaveAction, TestRenderClientActionMDL_Settings, TestActionSettings_DescribeParsesBackToTheSameAction, TestActionSettings_Refusals; roundtrip allowlists (PedApp 2, TestApp 4 entries struck)
